Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

DietView 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN release.
  • Badges removed from the README; the PDF step of the site build no longer blocks the deploy.

Changes since the first development version

  • dv_sunburst() now sizes wedges by prey records by default (mode = "occurrence"); the choices are ordered "occurrence", "weight", "count", as in run_dietview().
  • dv_build_html() draws the record and weight bands by default (bands = c("occurrence", "weight")); add "count" for distinct prey items.
  • Default colors follow the hierarchy: dv_build_html(), run_dietview() and the script of dv_script() use dv_palette_tree() built from the pooled tree of the whole prepared dataset, and dv_sunburst(colors = NULL) uses dv_palette_tree() of the tree drawn. A taxon keeps one color across panels and neighbouring wedges no longer share a color. dv_palette() is still exported for label-keyed colors.
  • dv_build_html(), run_dietview() and dv_script() share one argument for missing covariate values, na_strata = c("drop", "show"). The default leaves records with a missing value out of that covariate’s panels (the dashboard’s behaviour); "show" gives them an “NA” panel (the app’s previous behaviour, now opt-in).

Other changes

  • WoRMS lookups are batched and retried. dv_taxonomy_worms() reads records and matches names in chunks (getOption("DietView.worms_chunk", 50)) instead of one request per prey, retries a failed request up to getOption("DietView.worms_retries", 3) times with backoff (1, 2, 4 s), and reads “no match” from the HTTP status when the condition carries it (worrms 0.4 only gives it in the message, which stays the fallback). An AphiaID that WoRMS does not know falls back to the prey name, logged as match_type = "id_fallback_name" and listed by dv_taxonomy_report().
  • dv_prepare() gains stomachs (one row per examined stomach, empty ones included, e.g. ices_stomachs) and empty_col (the empty flag), stored in prep$stomachs. With it, dv_summary() adds n_examined, n_empty and pct_vacuity; dv_fo_table() gains denominator = c("nonempty", "examined"); and dv_matrix() gains include_empty to add all-zero rows for empty stomachs. Stomachs with neither a record nor an empty flag are of unknown status and left out. Without stomachs, nothing changes.
  • ices_lineage now gives the three unaccepted AphiaIDs of the ICES data the lineage of their accepted record (231869 -> Aphrodita aculeata, 400596 -> Trisopterus esmarkii, 298205 -> Lumpenus lampretaeformis), so Norway pout and the others are one node each and dv_lineage_check(ices_lineage) is clean. The keys are unchanged. The uncorrected table is the new dataset ices_lineage_raw, used to demonstrate dv_lineage_check().
  • The dashboard of dv_build_html() is drawn on demand: plotly.js is included once, the data of every sunburst is stored once as JSON, and a predator’s sunbursts are drawn the first time its tab is opened. On the full ICES data (22 predators, strata region/year/quarter) the file went from 17.1 MB to 4.1 MB with three bands (13.3 MB to 4.0 MB with two), and the build from 70 s to 9 s. The file still works offline and no longer needs rmarkdown or pandoc; self_contained = FALSE links plotly.js from a lib folder.
  • Dashboard cards are keyboard-accessible (role = "button", focusable, opened with Enter or Space).
  • Install from GitHub with pak::pak("SostheneA/DietView"); the README no longer points to an R-universe repository.
  • The documentation site is built by GitHub Actions and served from the gh-pages branch; the technical reference is also available as a PDF.
  • Lineage gaps are shown as "<ancestor> (no <rank>)". When WoRMS gives no taxon at a rank for a group (several polychaete families have no order, lancelets have no order, Priapulida have no class), dv_prepare() now fills that rank for records identified below it, e.g. "Polychaeta (no order)", instead of leaving them under the unidentified node. Gap nodes are light gray in the sunbursts, their hover text says they are identified material, and the counts per rank are stored in attr(prep, "lineage_gaps"). dv_aggregate_threshold(), dv_lineage_check(), richness counts and the digestion diagnostic treat gaps as “no taxon at this rank”. Use dv_prepare(gaps = "keep") for the previous behaviour.
  • Rank arguments are case-insensitive and accept the column name or the display label ("class", "Class", " CLASS ") in dv_rank_table(), dv_summary(), dv_prey_accumulation(), dv_fo_table(), dv_matrix() and dv_script(). dv_rank_table() now errors on an unknown rank instead of returning an empty table.
